title: Biohaven Oral Presentation at ASN Kidney Week 2026 Spotlights BHV-1420, a Novel TRAP Degrader Designed to Selectively Remove the Autoantibodies that Drive Membranous Nephropathy
summary: Biohaven Ltd. (NYSE: BHVN) (Biohaven) on Saturday presented preclinical data for BHV-1420 in an oral presentation at the American Society of Nephrology (ASN) Kidney Week 2026 in Denver, Colorado.
